title: 593. Encode and Decode TinyURL

examples.explanation: Encoding then decoding restores the original address.
Query strings survive the round trip untouched.

hints: Model the service with a small helper class holding two hash maps plus a counter for fresh codes.
Encode must be idempotent: an already-seen URL gets its earlier short link instead of a new one.
Decode by removing the fixed prefix and looking the code up; the round trip then equals the input.
